container.containregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each container record

container.containmodel.desc: A VARCHAR(40) naming or describing the container model/type

container.volliters.desc: An INTEGER specifying the container's internal volume in liters

container.masskg.desc: A REAL number for the container’s mass in kilograms (when empty, if applicable)

container.containflag.desc: A VARCHAR(30) field capturing a container status or classification (e.g., ‘In Transit’, ‘Active’, ‘Return’, ‘Delivered’)

container.coolkind.desc: A VARCHAR(40) describing the coolant type used within the container (e.g., Dry Ice, Liquid Nitrogen, Phase Change Material)

container.coolmass.desc: A REAL number indicating the mass (in kilograms) of the coolant present

container.coolremainpct.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) representing the remaining percentage of coolant

container.coolrefills.desc: A SMALLINT count of how many times coolant has been refilled

container.refilllatest.desc: A DATE recording the most recent coolant refill date

container.refillnext.desc: A DATE for the scheduled or expected next refill date

container.batterypct.desc: A REAL percentage of the container’s internal battery level, if battery-powered components exist

container.pwrfeed.desc: A VARCHAR(40) indicating the primary power feed or source (e.g., Battery, External, Hybrid)

container.pwrbackupflag.desc: A VARCHAR(40) specifying backup power availability status (e.g., Available, In Use, Not Available)

container.shipown.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry). Links this container to a shipment

datalogger.loggerreg.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each data logger record

datalogger.logflag.desc: An enum (DataLoggerStatus_enum) indicating the logger’s status (e.g., 'Malfunction', 'Battery Low', 'Active')

datalogger.loginterval.desc: A SMALLINT specifying the frequency (in minutes) at which the logger records or transmits data

datalogger.transmitflag.desc: An enum (TransmissionStatus_enum) indicating the data transmission status (e.g., 'Failed', 'Real-time', 'Delayed')

datalogger.datauptime.desc: A TIMESTAMP showing the logger’s current or last recorded operational uptime reading

datalogger.datapct.desc: A REAL value reflecting the logger’s used data capacity or data completeness in percentage

datalogger.batteryswap.desc: A DATE noting when the data logger battery was last replaced or swapped

datalogger.firmvers.desc: A VARCHAR(50) naming the firmware version installed on the data logger

datalogger.softupdate.desc: A TEXT field for recording any software update notes or logs

datalogger.syshealth.desc: An enum (SystemHealth_enum) describing the logger’s system health (e.g., 'Poor', 'Fair', 'Good')

datalogger.memusepct.desc: A SMALLINT for the percentage of the logger’s internal memory currently in use

datalogger.storecapmb.desc: An INTEGER representing the logger’s total storage capacity in megabytes

datalogger.storeremainmb.desc: An INTEGER indicating remaining/free storage in megabytes

datalogger.netsignal.desc: An enum (NetworkSignal_enum) representing network signal strength (e.g., 'Poor', 'Good', 'Excellent')

datalogger.commproto.desc: A VARCHAR(20) naming the communication protocol (e.g., RF, Bluetooth, Satellite, GSM)

datalogger.syncfreqhr.desc: A SMALLINT indicating how often (in hours) synchronization is attempted or performed

datalogger.containlog.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry). Connects the data logger to a container

datalogger.shiplog.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry). Optionally links the data logger to a shipment

regulatoryandmaintenance.regmaintregistr.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each regulatory/maintenance record

regulatoryandmaintenance.maintflag.desc: A VARCHAR(20) showing the maintenance status (e.g., ‘Overdue’, ‘Up to Date’, ‘Due’)

regulatoryandmaintenance.maintdatelast.desc: A DATE indicating the date of the most recent maintenance operation

regulatoryandmaintenance.maintdatenext.desc: A DATE specifying the scheduled or expected date for the next maintenance

regulatoryandmaintenance.calibdatelast.desc: A DATE for the most recent calibration event

regulatoryandmaintenance.calibdatenext.desc: A DATE for the next scheduled calibration

regulatoryandmaintenance.compscore.desc: A REAL number reflecting a compliance or condition score assigned to the shipment/vehicle

regulatoryandmaintenance.riskflag.desc: A VARCHAR(50) denoting risk level or category (e.g., ‘High Risk’, ‘Low Risk’, ‘Medium Risk’)

regulatoryandmaintenance.incidents.desc: A SMALLINT counting the number of recorded incidents or violations

regulatoryandmaintenance.resolveflag.desc: A VARCHAR(50) specifying how or if those incidents were resolved

regulatoryandmaintenance.respperson.desc: A VARCHAR(100) naming the responsible person or officer in charge

regulatoryandmaintenance.contactno.desc: A VARCHAR(50) for the primary contact phone/ID

regulatoryandmaintenance.contactemerg.desc: A VARCHAR(50) for emergency contact phone/ID details

regulatoryandmaintenance.inspectdatelast.desc: A DATE showing when the last official inspection was completed

regulatoryandmaintenance.inspectdatenext.desc: A DATE specifying when the next inspection is scheduled or due

regulatoryandmaintenance.inspectoutcome.desc: A VARCHAR(50) describing the overall outcome or result of the last inspection

regulatoryandmaintenance.correctactions.desc: A TEXT field detailing corrective actions taken post-inspection or post-incident

regulatoryandmaintenance.preventsteps.desc: A TEXT field describing preventive measures planned or implemented

regulatoryandmaintenance.validflag.desc: A VARCHAR(20) indicating the current validity status (e.g., 'In Process', 'Validated', 'Failed')

regulatoryandmaintenance.verifymethod.desc: A VARCHAR(50) naming the verification method or standard used

regulatoryandmaintenance.shipgov.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry), linking this record to a shipment

regulatoryandmaintenance.vehgov.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing TransportInfo(VehicleReg), linking this record to a vehicle

sensordata.sensortrack.desc: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each sensor data record

sensordata.storetempc.desc: A REAL value indicating the recommended or target storage temperature in Celsius

sensordata.temptolc.desc: A DECIMAL(4,1) specifying allowable temperature deviation (±°C)

sensordata.tempnowc.desc: A REAL number for the current actual temperature reading in Celsius

sensordata.tempdevcount.desc: A SMALLINT counting how many times the temperature has deviated beyond the allowed tolerance

sensordata.tempmaxc.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) representing the maximum temperature recorded (in °C)

sensordata.tempminc.desc: A DECIMAL(5,2) representing the minimum temperature recorded (in °C)

sensordata.tempstabidx.desc: A REAL value indicating a temperature stability index or coefficient

sensordata.humiditypct.desc: A DECIMAL(4,1) showing the percentage of humidity inside or around the container

sensordata.presskpa.desc: A REAL number representing the recorded pressure in kilopascals (kPa)

sensordata.shockflag.desc: An enum (SensorStatus_enum) describing the shock sensor status (e.g., Normal, Malfunction, Triggered)

sensordata.tiltflag.desc: An enum (SensorStatus_enum) describing the tilt sensor status (e.g., Normal, Triggered, Malfunction)

sensordata.impactflag.desc: An enum (SensorStatus_enum) describing the impact sensor status (e.g., Normal, Triggered, Malfunction)

sensordata.vibelvlmms.desc: A DECIMAL(6,2) measuring vibration level in mm/s (millimeters per second)

sensordata.lightlux.desc: An INTEGER for the current or last known light level in lux

sensordata.acceldata.desc: A REAL value capturing acceleration data (e.g., in m/s²) from the sensor

sensordata.handleevents.desc: A SMALLINT counting non-critical handling events (minor jolts, slight tilts)

sensordata.critevents.desc: A SMALLINT recording critical events (major shocks, severe impacts)

sensordata.alerts.desc: A SMALLINT tally of all sensor alerts triggered within a specific timeframe

sensordata.alerttime.desc: A TIMESTAMP marking the most recent alert event time

sensordata.alertkind.desc: A VARCHAR(50) describing the kind or category of the last triggered alert

sensordata.containlink.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry). Associates sensor data with a specific container

sensordata.vehsenseref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing TransportInfo(VehicleReg). Links sensor data to a particular vehicle

shipments.shipmentregistry.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each shipment record in the database

shipments.timemark.desc: A TIMESTAMP field indicating the exact date and time this shipment record was logged

shipments.routealign.desc: A VARCHAR(30) descriptor for the routing alignment or path code used by the shipment

shipments.customsflag.desc: An enum (CustomsFlag_enum) representing the customs clearance status (e.g., 'Cleared', 'In Process', 'Pending')

shipments.imppermitref.desc: A VARCHAR(50) referencing the import permit number or identifier for the shipment

shipments.exppermitref.desc: A VARCHAR(50) referencing the export permit number or identifier for the shipment

shipments.regprofile.desc: A VARCHAR(50) signifying the regulatory or profile reference for this shipment

shipments.insureflag.desc: An enum (InsuranceFlag_enum) capturing the insurance status (e.g., 'Active', 'Expired', 'Pending')

shipments.insureref.desc: A VARCHAR(50) referencing the insurance policy or coverage document number

shipments.qualcheck.desc: An enum (QualityCheck_enum) indicating the quality check result (e.g., 'Failed', 'Passed', 'Pending')

shipments.integritymark.desc: An enum (IntegrityStatus_enum) showing the shipment’s integrity status (e.g., 'Intact', 'Under Investigation', 'Compromised')

shipments.contamlevel.desc: An enum (ContaminationRisk_enum) denoting potential contamination risk level (e.g., 'High', 'Low', 'Medium')

shipments.packagestate.desc: An enum (PackageCondition_enum) describing the package condition (e.g., 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Poor', 'Good')

shipments.sealflag.desc: An enum (SecuritySealStatus_enum) for the security seal status (e.g., 'Broken', 'Intact', 'Missing')

shipments.sealref.desc: A VARCHAR(50) referencing a security seal ID or documentation

shipments.tampersign.desc: An enum (TamperEvidence_enum) noting tampering evidence (e.g., 'None Detected', 'Suspected', 'Confirmed')

shipments.handlingguide.desc: A TEXT field for special handling instructions or guidelines for the shipment

shipments.storagepose.desc: A VARCHAR(40) specifying how the shipment must be positioned or oriented during storage/transport

shipments.generalnote.desc: A TEXT field for any additional free-form notes regarding the shipment

transportinfo.vehiclereg.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the transport vehicle record

transportinfo.vehiclekind.desc: An enum (VehicleKind_enum) describing the vehicle type (e.g., 'Refrigerated Truck', 'Cargo Aircraft', 'Reefer Container')

transportinfo.vehtempc.desc: A REAL number for the current measured temperature (°C) inside the vehicle

transportinfo.speedkm.desc: A REAL number specifying the vehicle’s current speed in km/h

transportinfo.distdonekm.desc: A NUMERIC(9,2) indicating the distance already traveled (in kilometers)

transportinfo.distleftkm.desc: A NUMERIC(9,2) specifying the remaining distance (in kilometers) until destination

transportinfo.eta.desc: A TIMESTAMP for the estimated time of arrival at the destination

transportinfo.departsite.desc: A VARCHAR(100) naming the departure location/site

transportinfo.currentsite.desc: A VARCHAR(100) for the current location or site

transportinfo.destsite.desc: A VARCHAR(100) naming the destination location/site

transportinfo.gpsflag.desc: An enum (GPSTrackingStatus_enum) for GPS tracking status (e.g., 'Active', 'Lost', 'Limited')

transportinfo.latvalue.desc: A DOUBLE PRECISION value for the vehicle’s current latitude

transportinfo.lonvalue.desc: A DOUBLE PRECISION value for the vehicle’s current longitude

transportinfo.altmeter.desc: A REAL number denoting the vehicle’s altitude in meters above sea level

transportinfo.locupdatemin.desc: A SMALLINT specifying how frequently (in minutes) the vehicle’s location data is updated

transportinfo.locupdatemark.desc: A TIMESTAMP noting the last recorded location update time

transportinfo.transmode.desc: An enum (TransportMode_enum) indicating the mode of transport (e.g., 'Road', 'Rail', 'Air', 'Sea')

transportinfo.carrlabel.desc: A TEXT field with carrier or transporter identification/labeling information

transportinfo.carrcert.desc: A VARCHAR(50) referencing any carrier certification or license number

transportinfo.shiptransit.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry). Links vehicle to a shipment in transit

transportinfo.containtransit.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry). Links the vehicle to a container in transit

vaccinedetails.vacregistry.desc: A SERIAL primary key that uniquely identifies each vaccine detail record

vaccinedetails.vacvariant.desc: A VARCHAR(50) naming the vaccine type or variant (e.g., ‘Viral Vector’, ‘mRNA’, ‘Inactivated’, ‘Protein Subunit’)

vaccinedetails.mfgsource.desc: A TEXT field describing the manufacturer or source information of the vaccine

vaccinedetails.batchlabel.desc: A VARCHAR(50) specifying the batch or lot number label

vaccinedetails.prodday.desc: A DATE indicating the production/manufacture date of the vaccine batch

vaccinedetails.expireday.desc: A DATE specifying the vaccine’s expiration date

vaccinedetails.lotmeasure.desc: A BIGINT representing the quantity or measure of this vaccine lot (e.g., total units produced)

vaccinedetails.vialtally.desc: A SMALLINT counting how many vials are included in this particular batch

vaccinedetails.dosepervial.desc: A SMALLINT indicating the number of individual doses contained in each vial

vaccinedetails.dosetotal.desc: An INTEGER summing the total doses in this record (VialTally × DosePerVial)

vaccinedetails.shipinject.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry), tying this vaccine detail to a shipment

vaccinedetails.containvac.desc: A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Container(ContainRegistry), linking vaccine details to a specific container

relations.result: share of alerts that are critical (fraction)
